purpose: Source-constrained exterior and operational-interior reference for restoring two real fire facilities and improving Busan railway station without inventing as-built interiors

excluded: accounts, paid sources, access-control bypass, map-tile scraping, and unsupported APIs
as-built room geometry inferred from generic fire-station practice
station-specific fleet counts not explicitly published
scopeBoundary.evidenceRule: Source facts constrain geometry and functions; they do not become requirements or acceptance evidence by themselves. OSM is community geometry, not a survey. Photo observations remain view-limited.

facilities.label: 중앙119안전센터 / 부산 중부소방서

levels.evidence: OSM building:levels=4; official exterior photo is visually compatible with a ground apparatus tier plus upper horizontal facade tiers
levels.doNotInfer: No measured floor-to-floor height or total height is published

roof.observed: flat or very low-slope roof behind a parapet; rooftop equipment and a striped mast are visible

observedFacadeAndApproach: Front facade faces a paved apparatus apron and a road directly beyond it.
Three large ground-level apparatus openings are visually distinct; this is an opening count, not a vehicle-capacity or assigned-fleet count.
White/silver rectilinear cladding, red frame accents, long upper window bands, and fire-service signage are directly visible.
Photo is front-oblique/aerial and does not prove the rear or both side elevations.

notLocated: stairs, lift, dormitory, kitchen, lockers, decontamination, storage
interiorTopology.builderUse: May create one generic operations room as reference-derived function with inferred location; must label all adjacency, dimensions, and unseen support rooms INFERRED_GAMEPLAY.

facilities.label: 초량119안전센터

geometry.identityBasis: OSM polygon has the exact official city, district, street, house number, subdistrict and postcode but no facility name

levels.evidence: OSM building:levels=5; official exterior crop shows multiple occupied tiers but does not show the entire top edge clearly
levels.doNotInfer: No measured floor-to-floor height or total height is published

roof.observed: not visible in the official crop

observedFacadeAndApproach: At least three apparatus-frontage modules/openings are visible on the street facade; the leftmost is partly cropped.
Ground tier uses brown brick/stone facing; upper tiers use light rectangular panels with punched windows and several wall-mounted air-conditioning units.
A narrow glazed vertical strip is visible near the right side, but its circulation function is not established.
The image does not establish rear access, side-yard width, roof form, or a complete bay count.

notLocated: stairs, lift, dormitory, kitchen, lockers, decontamination, storage
interiorTopology.builderUse: May create one generic operations room as reference-derived function with inferred location; must label all adjacency, dimensions, and unseen support rooms INFERRED_GAMEPLAY.

facilities.label: 부산 철도역 (KTX/SRT)

geometry.criticalInterpretation: The polygon spans the elongated station/platform-roof complex. Do not treat its full area as the western public headhouse floor plate or extrude it as one uniform three-storey block.

levels.evidence: OSM building:levels=3 plus the photographed on-site convenience map explicitly labels 1F, 2F and 3F
levels.doNotInfer: No measured floor heights, structural grid, or complete platform geometry

roof.observed: broad shallow curved/cantilevered roof with a dark edge and repeated inclined supports over the glazed western facade

observedFacadeAndApproach: Official Korail photo provides a near-frontal western facade view with a broad plaza, multiple stair runs, central entrance canopy, extensive curtain wall, and glazed vertical circulation structures near facade edges.
Official parking/context image distinguishes the western station-front side from track-side 선상A, 선상B and 북항 parking zones.
No bounded official side or rear elevation photo was found; the front photo and OSM footprint are insufficient to recreate hidden elevations exactly.

interiorTopology.sourceClass: photograph of a station convenience-facility board from an unofficial post; the board itself appears on-site but date, scale and rights are unknown
directlyVisibleRelations: 1F is a public floor with a specialty-restaurant zone, toilets, elevators/escalators and baggage/retail uses.

2F is the main concourse: ticket windows and railway police are on the front/curved side; a central information area and multiple signed track-access directions are shown; toilets, elevators and escalators repeat across the concourse.
3F is a smaller partial floor centered on a specialty-restaurant zone with toilets and elevator/escalator access.
Vertical circulation appears in several clusters rather than one central core.
interiorTopology.officialFacilityApiConstraint: Korail floor API records and the three retained 1F/2F/3F images prove floor-labelled public amenities, but those images are shop photos, not plans.
interiorTopology.builderUse: Use only floor membership, broad public-function zones, track-access directionality, and repeated vertical-circulation hubs. Keep wall lengths, room shapes, structural elements, service rooms, platform detail and emergency routes INFERRED_GAMEPLAY. Never derive dimensions from pixels.

apparatusRoleEvidence.scope: 중부소방서 aggregate across headquarters, five safety centers and one rescue unit; not station assignment
apparatusRoleEvidence.implementationBoundary: These published types justify a scalable role taxonomy. They do not justify assigning any count or specific vehicle to 중앙119 or 초량119. Low-resolution exterior photos show parked vehicles but do not reliably classify or inventory them.

acquisitionLimits: Only one public official exterior angle per depot was available on the designated Busan Fire pages; secondary images are interior operations rooms, not side elevations.
No official measured plans, floor heights, bay dimensions, rear elevations, or room adjacency diagrams were found for either fire facility.
Korail station page currently may return a service-guidance shell; retained official files are hashed and their original URLs recorded.
The station convenience board is useful for topology only and is not an official downloadable floor plan.
All calculated areas and extents are pipeline measurements from OSM polygons and must remain approximate reference geometry.
No claim in this graph constitutes digital-twin, as-built, current-fleet, or product acceptance.
